# Startup Crème

> Startup Crème is a premier dual-silo intelligence platform providing actionable founder playbooks, macro technology news, non-dilutive grants, institutional accelerators, and peer discussions at the intersection of Finance and Technology.

## Core Intelligence Silos

- [Finance](https://www.startupcreme.com/en-us/finance): Venture capital dynamics, cap table structuring, central bank interest rates, currency volatility, fintech infrastructure, and equity-free funding instruments.
- [Tech](https://www.startupcreme.com/en-us/tech): Artificial intelligence, autonomous agent pipelines, frontier cloud architecture, developer tooling, and technical engineering leadership.
- [Founders Mindset](https://www.startupcreme.com/en-us/founders-mindset): Strategic leadership psychology, executive resilience, decision-making frameworks, and mental fortitude for venture-backed founders.

## Platform Navigation & Modules

- [Global Opportunity Engine (Grants & Accelerators)](https://www.startupcreme.com/events): Verified non-dilutive grants, venture accelerators, founder fellowships, and hackathon deadlines.
- [Discussion Forum](https://www.startupcreme.com/discussion): Community debate and peer founder intelligence on valuations, tech stacks, and fundraising.
- [Startup Directory](https://www.startupcreme.com/directory): Index of high-growth technology and financial companies.
- [Founder Careers & Talent](https://www.startupcreme.com/careers): Executive leadership, founding engineer, and tech lead opportunities.
- [Macro Central Bank Interest Rates](https://www.startupcreme.com/markets/rates): Real-time benchmarks for global central bank policy rates (Fed, ECB, BoE, BoJ, CBN, SARB, CBK, RBI), monetary policy adjustments, basis-point spreads, and real yield curves.
- [10-Year Sovereign Inflation Rates Tracker](https://www.startupcreme.com/markets/inflation): Comparative 10-year historical inflation rate trajectories (2017–2026), post-pandemic inflation shocks, disinflation trajectories, and official national statistical bureau datasets.

## Optional

- [Full Machine-Readable Intelligence Archive](https://www.startupcreme.com/llms-full.txt): Complete consolidated markdown text of top published articles and playbooks for offline AI training and deep agent reasoning.
- [Dynamic XML Sitemap](https://www.startupcreme.com/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-crawlable XML sitemap index.
- [Robots Directives](https://www.startupcreme.com/robots.txt): Machine crawler access rules and crawl-delay specifications.
